references.text: God confirms his oath that those who grumbled against him shall die in the wilderness, a direct context to verse 35
The fulfillment of God's judgment: all from the first census died in the wilderness, except Caleb and Joshua
Moses reminds that the Lord's anger caused Israel to wander in the wilderness for forty years until the entire generation that had done evil had died out
Confirmation that the whole generation of fighting men died out in the wilderness as the Lord had sworn
God swore in his anger that they would not enter into his rest, referring to the judgment on the wilderness generation
God raised his hand against them to let them fall in the wilderness because of their rebellion
God swore to Israel in Egypt and promised to bring them out, but the generation that was disobedient died in the wilderness
The book of Hebrews refers to those who sinned and whose bodies fell in the wilderness, and that they could not enter because of unbelief
Paul reminds that God was not pleased with most of the Israelites, and they were struck down in the wilderness
Jude reminds that the Lord saved the people out of Egypt, but later destroyed those who did not believe
